label: Fires at D1 after an unrewarded rare a1->S2 trial, more if the trial before was unrewarded too.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 r")
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("action", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * (tv("action", -3) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 r") * (tv("action", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("action", -2) == -9)
explanation: D1-only feature (zero at GO and D2). Its magnitude is driven almost entirely by the previous trial being a1 -> S2 (rare) unrewarded, the outcome a model-based agent should treat as stay-on-a1. It is larger when the trial before that was also unrewarded, and slightly raised after a1 S2 rewarded. Belief log-odds, belief cover, and the actions or states two trials back add little (<0.02). The free fit (7 terms, dev 0.40) is barely better than the 3-term short form (dev 0.39), and both sit near the observed-cue ceiling (0.41). Within a1 S2 u the activation is bimodal (about 1.6 vs 0) and observed history does not separate the two modes well; the remaining variance tracks the model policy decile, which observed-only terms cannot use.
